characters.summary: Carol Danvers fights using direct physical onslaughts augmented by cosmic energy manipulation, photon blasts, and high-speed aerial movement. She can absorb massive amounts of energy and redirect it against opponents.
weaknesses: Supreme Intelligence Supressor Inhibitor implant (initially restricted her full powers)
limitations: Initially limited by the Kree control implant placed in her neck

sources.supports: Origins, cosmic powers, photon blasts, and general capabilities in the MCU.
Energy absorption capabilities and team dynamics in The Marvels.

feats.claim: Flew through the sanctuary II warship and destroyed it completely from the inside
Absorbed energy from a localized star to help restart a dying sun

notableResults.note: Overpowered Thanos briefly until he used the Power Stone to blast her away.

conditional.dependsOn: Removal of the Kree suppressor device

campaignTags.claim: Natural supersonic/faster-than-light flight in space and atmosphere
Can fly entirely under her own power without equipment

unknowns: Exact upper limits of energy absorption capacity before overload.

characters.summary: In her light-based quantum/binary entanglement state, Carol projects massive glowing cosmic energy, increasing her outward photonic output and flight aura.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to complex quantum entanglement disruptions
limitations: Tied to quantum entanglement instability with other light-manipulating individuals
characters.formDifferences: Exhibits a permanent glowing binary aura and elevated energy-projection capabilities due to quantum entanglement with light-based portals.

sources.supports: Quantum entanglement abilities and binary visual manifestations.

feats.claim: Repaired a tear in hyperspace using sustained cosmic light emission

conditional.dependsOn: Quantum entanglement anomaly involving Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan

campaignTags.claim: Can fly using quantum energy auras
Innate powered flight state via light-based transformation

unknowns: Whether this form can be maintained indefinitely without external quantum triggers.

limitations: Relies heavily on mental dominance; highly arrogant

weaknesses: Can be distracted by typical canine impulses (e.g., being called a 'good dog')
limitations: Limited physical combat prowess without telekinesis

weaknesses: Standard human physical vulnerability with no superpowers or martial arts training
limitations: Entirely ordinary human with no combat training

Darcy's role as an astrophysicist analyzing the Hex anomaly.

weaknesses: Sensory overload from loud noises or extreme chemical smells
limitations: Blindness requires total reliance on radar sense

weaknesses: Refuses to attack enemies, leaving him defenseless against unprovoked aggression
limitations: Strict self-imposed pacifism prevents aggressive action

unknowns: How long this psychological inversion lasts before reverting to standard violent Deadpool.
